Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC ACTREC Scientific Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Scientific Assistant. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Scientific Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Scientific Assistant post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 08 September 2026. Candidates should report on this date.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Scientific Assistant post?
faq.answer: Required qualifications include M.Sc. in Statistics, IT, Computer Science, Public Health, Biotechnology, or Life Science. M. Tech/B. Tech Biotechnology is also accepted.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any experience required for this post?
faq.answer: One year of experience in Cancer registry is desirable for the Scientific Assistant post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the Scientific Assistant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Scientific Assistant post is 35 years. Age relaxation may be provided based on experience.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Scientific Assistant position?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 28,450/- to Rs. 35,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an MCQ Examination followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the interview venue located?
faq.answer: The interview venue is located at Advanced Centre for Treatment Research and Education in Cancer (TMC ACTREC), Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, 410210.
